text: Gemma, thank you for sorting the subscriptions yesterday saved me a real headache
No bother, all paid through to march. Will send receipts round later
Has anyone been up to the site this week? The gate lock was stiff on Sunday
I'll look on Thursday. Might need a drop of oil

sorry been offline all day, what did i miss 😅

ah ok 👍🙏 ill come thurs if ppl need a hand, shifts done by 4 😊
